_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.45.0 and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.62.0, the pair that adds tab comments (pine-lang returns a leading comment as `doc` and stops deleting it when it reformats an expression; beamlynx-ui shows and edits it on the canvas) and lets two saved connections share a host:port with different databases (pine-lang folds the database name into a connection's id).
